content.text:
I submitted **index 8 (In 0.77 / Sb 0.23)** as the best composition. Its EQE was 0.0015%, the highest of the three I could measure, but that is barely above zero.

| Index | In / Sb | EQE (%) |
|---|---|---|
| 8 | 0.77 / 0.23 | **0.0015** |
| 21 | 0.36 / 0.64 | −0.0005 |
| 2 | 0.87 / 0.13 | −0.0030 |

- **Choosing where to measure:** the phase database lists three In–Sb mixed oxides along this line. I measured near two of them, In11Sb3O24 (index 8) and In3Sb5O12 (index 21). The third, InSbO4 at 50/50, I only checked by XRD.
- **XRD:**
  - Indices 17 and 21 give nearly the same simple pattern. It fits none of the listed In–Sb mixed-oxide phases (all similarity scores 0.05 or lower).
  - Index 8 has more peaks and matches the In11Sb3O24 and InSbO4 references best, but only weakly (similarity about 0.34 and 0.32).
- **Last measurement:** after the first two results, the Gaussian-process model recommended the In-rich end. I measured index 2 there and it came out lowest.

Every result is within about ±0.003% of zero, so the three measurements can't really be told apart. This is expected: these oxides mostly have band gaps wider than the 2.4 eV light, so they absorb little of it. I only measured 3 of the 30 compositions, so a better one elsewhere on the line (for example indices 10–16 or the Sb-rich end) can't be ruled out. Two of the five XRD scans were left unused.
